info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account TestPerformance API
Returns waterfall tokens based on test IDs.

params.name: testId
params.description: Test ID to get waterfall tokens for

params.name: nodeIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Node IDs

params.name: startTimeUtc
params.description: Start time in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

params.name: endTimeUtc
params.description: End time in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

items.docs:
*[Analytics Endpoint]*
            
Returns the waterfall tokens for last three hours of a specified test if no time range is specified. The tokens returned include “verify on failure” test runs too.

info.name: Returns raw performance data for the provided Test IDs.

params.name: testIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Test IDs

params.name: startTimeUtc
params.description: Start Time in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

params.name: endTimeUtc
params.description: End Time in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

params.name: subSourceTypeId
params.description: Sub source type ID (refer InternalLink[Test Raw Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-TestPerformance,operations-TestPerformance-get_v2_tests_explorer_enumeration])

params.name: dimensionIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of dimensions (refer InternalLink[Test Raw Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-TestPerformance,operations-TestPerformance-get_v2_tests_explorer_enumeration]). The data will be grouped and broken down based on these dimensions

params.name: metricIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of metric IDs (refer InternalLink[Test Raw Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-TestPerformance,operations-TestPerformance-get_v2_tests_explorer_enumeration]). All metrics are returned if no value is passed.

params.name: tracepointIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Tracepoint IDs

params.name: zoneTypeIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Zone Type IDs. ”-2” for Self Zone and “-3” for Third Party Zone.

params.name: availabilityFilter
params.description: Comma-separated list of Availability Filter IDs. (OnlyFailures = 0, OnlySuccesses = 1, All = 2, OnlyContentFailures = 3, OnlyJavascriptFailures = 4, SLA = 5, SLAAcceptedRuns = 6, SLAPurgedRuns = 7, RealTimePushApiFailures = 8)

params.name: verifyOnError
params.description: Include Verify on Error Run. Default is false.

items.docs:
*[Analytics Endpoint]*
            
The raw data returned is in UTC. If no time is specified, the last 1-hour raw data is returned. Use parameters to query specific dimensions.
